name: How long does mold remediation under a sink take?

mainEntity.name: How long does mold remediation under a sink take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of mold remediation under a sink depends on the size of the affected area and the complexity of the damage. A small, easily accessible mold spot might be addressed in a single day. However, if structural components are affected or extensive drying is required, the process could take several days to ensure complete removal and proper drying. A professional assessment can provide a more precise timeline.
acceptedAnswer.description: Mold remediation under a sink can take from one day to several, depending on the mold's extent and whether structural components are affected.
